name: smwmusic-metal-beyond-minds
title: Metal - Beyond Minds
description:
NOTE: Incompatible w/ Thunder, Blaargs, Yoshi and the Bonus End song.

A tracker song called Beyond Minds, tracked by Torben "Metal" Hansen. It's an almost 3 minute loop, so it's perfect for levels that the player is going to spend a long long time on. Could fit abstract or industrial levels.
